skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to all enemies for 7000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] (affected only by advanced DMG modifiers), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. The 1st hit has a 150% chance to inflict [Disorder]. ———- [Disorder]: Before any character acts, if the target is not under [Specialized Unyielding] or [Ultimate Unyielding], deals 4000% [Disorder DMG] (based on Rover's ATK), ignoring 100% [DoT DMG Reduction] and penetrating [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Each [Disorder] triggers up to 3 times and can stack.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: [Specialized Direct DMG] 7000% > 9000% ATK. Ignores [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%. [Disorder DMG] 4000% > 5500%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20 Max HP. On entry, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and grants all allies 70% [True DMG Reduction] while dispelling [DoT DMG Bonus Reduction] from all allies for the entire battle. When [Re-Battle] triggers, this unit's [Charged Pursuit] Ultimate power rises to 1.1x.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 60% > 70%. All allies' [True DMG Reduction] 70% > 75%. [Re-Battle] [Charged Pursuit] power 1.1x > 1.2x.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 70% > 80%. All allies' [True DMG Reduction] 75% > 80%. [Re-Battle] [Charged Pursuit] power 1.2x > 1.25x.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, permanently reduces the ignore-DMG action count of all enemies' [Ultimate Unyielding] by 1, and gains 3 stacks of [Re-Fight]. ———- [Re-Fight]: Permanently reduces DMG taken by 75% (+2.5% each return to the field). When a same-row ally (or all allies) are defeated while this unit is also defeated, consume 1 [Re-Fight] stack to return at 100% HP and launch a [Charged Pursuit] on a random target at 120% Ultimate power; other defeated same-row allies have a 70% chance to also trigger. (Only one of [Re-Fight], [Revenge], [Regroup] or [Momentum Return] can be active at a time.)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: All enemies' [Ultimate Unyielding] ignore-DMG action count 1 > 2. [Re-Fight] stacks 3 > 5. [Re-Fight] DMG reduction 75% > 78% (+2.5% > 2.8% each return). [Charged Pursuit] power 120% > 135%. Other same-row allies' trigger chance 70% > 100%.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
The shield ignores top tier damage, blocks certain incoming attacks, and when activated can deal massive Chaos damage, bypassing normal dodge/reduction effects.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Reduces incoming true damage by a large percentage (e.g. 70%), a rare shield against normally unblockable damage.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
Before a character acts, if without a shield, suffer heavy ST-based Disorder DMG. Cumulative; disappears after activation.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Massive ST damage type associated with the Disorder debuff, ignores ST Reduction over time and penetrates Specialized Evasion, disappears after activation.
Permanently reduces damage taken; When defeated, spend a layer to return to 100% Health and pursue.
